why_smaller.title: IREN / IREN — a miner acquires an AI and payout story
why_smaller.selection_evidence: CoinDesk reported bitcoin miner IREN surging on renewed AI interest and the possibility of a bitcoin dividend.[[n4287]] That combines several accessible ideas: digital-asset exposure, a fashionable technology opportunity and a potential distribution to holders. The attraction is that a miner might have more than one way to capture investor interest. The conditional wording matters. A possible dividend is a proposal or possibility to assess, rather than a payment already earned by every new buyer, and renewed AI attention does not establish completed AI earnings.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: a miner acquires an AI and payout story

why_smaller.title: Trump Media / DJT — conviction reaches the retirement account
why_smaller.selection_evidence: Fortune described one investor putting 98% of retirement funds into Trump Media and refusing to sell because of a belief in a secret Trump plan.[[n4199]] That is a specific reported account, not a claim that all holders invest this way. It nevertheless exposes the emotional attraction unusually clearly: political conviction can turn a stock into an expression of trust and identity. The investor may then interpret disagreement or a drawdown as a test of loyalty, making ordinary portfolio limits harder to apply. A company's actual economics still determine what common shareholders own.

why_smaller.title: Private-company access / DXYZ — the wrapper is part of the wager
why_smaller.selection_evidence: 24/7 Wall St. described DXYZ continuing to rise, renewing the investment conversation around access to private-company opportunities.[[n4189]] The attraction is a listed instrument that appears to open a door usually closed to an ordinary brokerage account. That scarcity can make the market quotation itself seem valuable. A buyer still owns the fund's actual portfolio on its actual terms, rather than a direct stake in every famous company associated with the broader private-market story. The access narrative should begin an appraisal of the wrapper, not replace it.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: the wrapper is part of the wager
